<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="0.58" stop-color="#FFF5FA"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#F9EAF3"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="pinkGlow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FF007A"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#E8006F"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="180%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="8"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="23" y="27" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="23" x2="326" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="23" x2="331" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="336" y1="23" x2="336" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="349" cy="19" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="346" y1="22" x2="343" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="361" y="14" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="363" y="16" width="14" height="7" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="382" y="17" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- abstract onboarding illustration shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="258" rx="132" ry="120" fill="#E8006F" opacity="0.10" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <!-- abstract pink illustration -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="250" r="104" fill="#FF007A" opacity="0.10"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="250" r="80" fill="none" stroke="#FF007A" stroke-width="23" opacity="0.20"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="250" r="52" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.88"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="250" r="39" fill="url(#pinkGlow)"/>
  <polygon points="195,215 205,241 233,242 211,259 219,287 195,271 171,287 179,259 157,242 185,241" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="99" cy="188" r="18" fill="#E8006F" opacity="0.86"/>
  <circle cx="294" cy="307" r="25" fill="#FF007A" opacity="0.22"/>
  <circle cx="112" cy="329" r="10" fill="#FF007A"/>
  <circle cx="286" cy="164" r="11" fill="#E8006F"/>
  <rect x="76" y="249" width="28" height="28" rx="10" fill="#FF007A" opacity="0.42" transform="rotate(-22 90 263)"/>
  <rect x="287" y="226" width="32" height="32" rx="12" fill="#E8006F" opacity="0.25" transform="rotate(24 303 242)"/>
  <polyline points="91,152 103,142 115,152" fill="none" stroke="#FF007A" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <polyline points="282,348 294,337 306,348" fill="none" stroke="#E8006F" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="69" y1="302" x2="82" y2="302" stroke="#FF007A" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="75.5" y1="295.5" x2="75.5" y2="308.5" stroke="#FF007A" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="315" y1="190" x2="328" y2="190" stroke="#E8006F" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="321.5" y1="183.5" x2="321.5" y2="196.5" stroke="#E8006F" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <polygon points="130,136 136,148 149,150 140,159 142,172 130,166 118,172 120,159 111,150 124,148" fill="#FF007A" opacity="0.56"/>
  <polygon points="264,331 269,341 280,343 272,351 274,362 264,357 254,362 256,351 248,343 259,341" fill="#E8006F" opacity="0.48"/>

  <!-- heading and supporting copy -->
  <text x="195" y="432" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial" font-size="28" font-weight="600" fill="#181818">Buy, swap, and send</text>
  <text x="195" y="466" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial" font-size="28" font-weight="600" fill="#181818">crypto tokens.</text>
  <text x="195" y="505" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#A9AAB2">Your wallet, your assets, your control.</text>

  <!-- primary button shadow and button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="33" y="552" width="326" height="66" rx="20" fill="#181818" opacity="0.10" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <rect x="32" y="548" width="326" height="64" rx="20" fill="#E8006F"/>
    <text x="195" y="588" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Create a new wallet</text>
  </g>

  <!-- secondary action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="32" y="628" width="326" height="52" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.72" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="661" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#FF007A">Import an existing wallet</text>
  </g>

  <!-- security note card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="34" y="697" width="322" height="64" rx="20" fill="#181818" opacity="0.07" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <rect x="32" y="694" width="326" height="64" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="61" cy="726" r="16" fill="#FF007A1A"/>
    <rect x="55" y="721" width="12" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#E8006F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="57,721 57,717 59,714 63,714 66,717 66,721" fill="none" stroke="#E8006F" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="88" y="720" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#181818">Your keys, your crypto</text>
    <text x="88" y="741" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#A9AAB2">Keep your recovery phrase private.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="778" width="390" height="66" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="38,800 48,791 58,800" fill="none" stroke="#FF007A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="41" y="799" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FF007A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="48" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#FF007A">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="126" cy="798" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#A9AAB2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="132" y1="804" x2="139" y2="811" stroke="#A9AAB2" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="126" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#A9AAB2">Explore</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="185" y="791" width="22" height="16" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#A9AAB2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="190,807 194,807 190,812" fill="#A9AAB2"/>
    <circle cx="192" cy="799" r="1.5" fill="#A9AAB2"/>
    <circle cx="200" cy="799" r="1.5" fill="#A9AAB2"/>
    <text x="196" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#A9AAB2">Activity</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="283" cy="797" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#A9AAB2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="283" cy="809" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#A9AAB2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="283" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#A9AAB2">Wallet</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="352" cy="798" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#A9AAB2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="352" cy="798" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#A9AAB2" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="352" y1="785" x2="352" y2="789" stroke="#A9AAB2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="352" y1="807" x2="352" y2="811" stroke="#A9AAB2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="352" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#A9AAB2">Settings</text>
  </g>
</svg>
